about: Images of the blog redrawn in the series' look with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst through Runway (krizaka-internal#2455). Prompts, references, takes and the credits the account showed; the files are on Bunny, never committed.

characters.chouf: a small orange-brown kestrel (the watcher, watchdog.py): perched, looking down the tracks
characters.pompier: a small red duck with round glasses (the firefighter, since replaced by the crack): on the siding beside the fire
characters.pigeon: a small blue-grey rock pigeon, which delivers (the letterbox)

series-23-the-trains-second-version-rail.prompt:
Use the four reference pictures only for their style: a real hand-drawn illustration, loose fine pen-and-ink linework of varying weight (thin, broken, scratchy lines, never uniform outlines), transparent watercolor washes that bleed and pool, visible cold-press paper grain, a deckled uneven unpainted paper margin, palette of deep indigo, teal, warm orange and soft cream, muted and slightly desaturated. Absolutely not a cartoon: no big eyes, no cel shading, no flat vector fills, no glossy gradients, no digital smoothness, no anthropomorphism (birds stand and perch like real birds, no clothes, no hands). Birds are small in the frame and drawn naturalistically with a few ink strokes, as in the references. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
Scene: a small railway yard at dusk after the first snow, seen from a low angle, wide landscape composition like the references: three tracks running toward a modest wooden station, a wagon resting on a siding under a red lamp, a little repair draisine with a glowing lantern alone on the middle track. On a signal post at the left edge a small orange-brown falcon (a kestrel) sits upright, watching the tracks: the watcher. Near the draisine stands a small red duck with a flat yellow bill and small round glasses, the repairer, seen from the side. Two small birds only, no others.

The rails fade into the distance behind, the little station with lit windows far away. One bird only. Wide landscape composition with a deckled paper margin.

credits.note: Runway's organization endpoint, balance before and after each take; the account is shared with the home session, so two deltas (65 and 62) include its own generations. This blog's takes: 7 medium (6 credits each) and 1 high (cover 23, at most 65).
